name: microserver
description: MicroPython, Microdot and Pi Pico W example of creating web-based embedded applications.

paragraphs: The contents of this folder install a webserver application on a WiFi-enabled board running MicroPython. The server is a simple web page offering the ability to turn LED's on or off. The page is served by a small web server library called microdot, which was written for MicroPython, running on a Pico W. This demo is intended to serve as a simple, iterative example as to how to develop a user-facing webpage running on the Pico W.
